d: Our client is a Kuwait-based financial services company offering investment solutions aligned with Sharia principles.
Lead the company's financial strategy, planning, budgeting and capital allocation to support business growth.
Partner with the CEO and Board on strategic decisions, financial performance and long-term priorities.
Oversee financial reporting and ensure compliance with Kuwait Capital Markets Authority (CMA) requirements.
Manage treasury, cash flow, banking relationships, reconciliations and financial operations.
Strengthen internal controls and manage liquidity, currency, credit and operational financial risks.
Lead financial reporting to investors and support fundraising, due diligence and potential transactions.
Build and develop the finance team, ensuring the function supports the company's evolving needs.
Improve financial systems and reporting capabilities to provide accurate, timely insights.
Collaborate with Technology and Operations on financial processes, settlement activities and new market initiatives.
Manage relationships with regulators, external auditors and financial advisors.
q: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field; CFA, CPA, ACCA, CA or equivalent.
Minimum 12 years of progressive finance experience, including 3–5 years in an executive or equivalent senior leadership role.
Proven experience as a CFO, Deputy CFO, VP Finance or equivalent within regulated financial services, fintech or capital markets.
In-depth knowledge of Kuwait CMA regulations, financial compliance and regulatory reporting requirements.
Strong expertise in financial planning, treasury, internal controls, budgeting and capital management.
Demonstrated experience building and leading finance teams in a growing business.
Experience presenting to boards, investors and regulators, with the ability to translate complex financial information into clear recommendations.
Exposure to equities, ETFs, brokerage platforms or multi-market investment products is advantageous.
Experience supporting fundraising, M&A or IPO processes is preferred.
Strong commercial judgment, analytical skills and commitment to integrity and transparency.
Proficiency in Arabic and English is preferred.

d: We are currently seeking passionate and dynamic Finance professionals who pride themselves on their ability to deliver extraordinary levels of customer service and provide creative solutions to our guests.
As an Income Auditor you are responsible for ensuring the compliance of all revenue guidelines established in the Hotel.
q: You should have a degree in hotel management or accounting and at least one year previous experience within a hotel environment. Excellent verbal and written English communication skills and computer literacy are required, while knowledge of Opera, Micros, FBM and SUN systems is an asset.
The ideal candidate will be an analytical, pragmatic thinker with a high level of integrity and professionalism.
You are results-oriented, able to adjust priorities and manage time wisely in a fast-paced environment and maintain a fair, consistent set of standards.
You are proactive and flexible, while possessing the following additional competencies
r: Verify and submit all income reports on a daily basis for approval of the Director of Finance and General Manager
Verify all selling prices are approved as per the approval matrix and all changes in the micros and other POS are verified
Follow up and take necessary actions on audit discrepancies with Front Office and Food & Beverage teams
Prepare and update house fund receipts and carry out spot checks on cashier floats, revenue vouchers, discount cards etc.
Verify the visa expenses, commission vouchers, loyalty points to ensure compliance with Hotel and corporate guidelines
Manage the Outlet Cashiers training and rosters
Prepare the General Cashier report and posts them to sun Systems on a daily basis
Post the revenue and statistics journal to the sun systems on a daily basis
Maintain sequential control on revenue vouchers, receipts, Outlet checks to minimize or eradicate chances of fraud
Operate in a safe and environmentally friendly way to protect guests " and employees" health and safety, as well as protect and conserve the environment
Comply with the hotel environmental, health and safety policies and procedures

d: The Legal Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and following up on the company's legal matters, managing legal documentation, monitoring cases and claims, and ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations in Saudi Arabia. The role is performed on a part-time basis according to the agreed working schedule.
q: Bachelor's degree in Law, Legal Studies, or a related field.
Must have completed legal training or be currently undergoing training at a licensed law firm.
Good knowledge of Saudi labor and commercial laws.
Familiarity with Saudi government and legal platforms.
Strong organizational, communication, and documentation skills.
Ability to handle confidential information professionally.

This is a part-time position, with working hours determined by mutual agreement based on the company's operational requirements. The employee must ensure timely follow-up on assigned legal matters and meet all applicable deadlines.
Timely follow-up on legal cases and deadlines.
Accuracy and completeness of legal documentation.
Regular updates on pending legal matters.
Effective coordination with lawyers and relevant departments.
Completion of assigned tasks within agreed timelines.

Note: The Legal Coordinator performs administrative and legal coordination duties. Providing independent legal opinions or representing the company before courts is subject to applicable professional licensing requirements and company authorization.
r: Follow up on legal cases, disputes, and claims involving the company.
Coordinate with external lawyers, legal consultants, and relevant authorities.
Prepare and organize documents and supporting evidence required for legal proceedings.
Monitor court hearing dates, legal deadlines, and case updates.
Maintain updated records of ongoing legal matters.
Assist in preparing and reviewing contracts and legal agreements.
Coordinate contract reviews and approvals with the relevant departments.
Monitor contract expiration dates, renewals, and terminations.
Maintain organized and confidential records of legal documents.
Monitor relevant changes in Saudi laws and regulations.
Assist in ensuring company compliance with applicable legal requirements.
Follow up on legal notices, violations, and official correspondence.
Identify potential legal risks and report them to management.
Coordinate legal transactions with government and judicial authorities.
Follow up on cases and requests through relevant government platforms, including Najiz.
Prepare official letters and legal correspondence.
Monitor the implementation of legal decisions and required procedures.
Coordinate with the HR Department regarding labor disputes and employee-related legal matters.
Prepare and organize documents related to employment contracts, warnings, investigations, and terminations.
Follow up on labor complaints and claims.
Support the preparation of legal documentation related to disciplinary procedures.
Prepare periodic reports on legal cases, claims, contracts, and pending matters.
Maintain accurate and updated legal records.
Ensure confidentiality of all company legal information.
Complete assigned legal tasks within the required deadlines.
Perform other related duties assigned by management.
